name: Fairchild AFB
description: Home of the 92nd Air Refueling Wing. Fairchild AFB provides global air refueling with KC-135 Stratotankers and supports the Air Force Survival, Evasion, Resistance, and Escape (SERE) school.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate.

gates.name: Main Gate
gates.notes: Primary 24/7 access with visitor processing. After-hours visitor passes issued here.

gates.name: Visitor Control Center (Bldg 4203)
gates.hours: Mon-Fri 0600-1600; closed weekends, federal holidays, and AMC Family Days
gates.notes: Day passes and visitor registration. REAL ID required. Located at 302 E. Arnold St.
gates.address: 302 E. Arnold St, Bldg 4203, Fairchild AFB, WA 99011

resources.name: Warrior Dining Facility
resources.description: Primary DFAC supporting air refueling and SERE training missions.
resources.address: 100 W. Bong St, Fairchild AFB, WA 99011

resources.name: Flight Kitchen
resources.description: Flight line dining support for aircrew and mission personnel.
resources.address: 100 W. Bong St, Fairchild AFB, WA 99011

resources.name: Fairchild Main Exchange (BX)
resources.description: Full-service Exchange with retail, services, and food court options.
resources.address: 101 W. Spaatz Rd, Fairchild AFB, WA 99011

resources.name: Global Credit Union
resources.description: Full-service credit union branch on base with ATM.

resources.name: Fitness & Sports Center
resources.description: Main fitness facility with indoor pool, cardio, weights, group exercise, racquetball, basketball, parent-child area, and 24/7 access by registration.
resources.hours: See FSS for staffed hours; 24/7 access available
resources.address: 300 W. Castle St, Fairchild AFB, WA 99011

resources.name: Fairchild Inn (AF Lodging)
resources.description: Official temporary lodging including DVQ and TLF. 24-hour front desk. Survival Inn available for SERE students.
resources.address: 300 N. Short St, Fairchild AFB, WA 99011

resources.name: Military & Family Readiness Center (M&FRC)
resources.description: Relocation assistance, financial counseling, employment support, family programs, and Total Force readiness. Right Start orientation coordinated here.
resources.address: 4 W. Castle St, Bldg 2365, Fairchild AFB, WA 99011

resources.name: 92nd Force Support Squadron (FSS)
resources.description: Full MWR, dining, fitness, lodging, recreation, and family support programs.
resources.hours: See directory for individual facility hours

resources.name: Outdoor Recreation
resources.description: Equipment rental, FamCamp, and recreational programs.

resources.name: Fairchild Golf Course
resources.description: 18-hole golf course with pro shop and dining.

resources.name: 92nd Medical Group
resources.description: Primary care, specialty clinics, and TRICARE services.

primaryAction.title: Visitor Control Center (Bldg 4203)
primaryAction.address: 302 E. Arnold St, Bldg 4203, Fairchild AFB, WA 99011

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage and birth certificates if applicable, and travel receipts for finance settlement.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Fairchild Inn (509-244-2290) for initial arrival. Dormitory Management for unaccompanied housing. Family housing through privatized housing office.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 92 FSS, M&FRC, and official Fairchild sites for in-processing and air refueling mission support.
